newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Pohang Iron & Steel at A plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Pohang Iron & Steel at A plus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it affirmed Pohang Iron & Steel Co.'s (Posco) A plus senior unsecured debt ratings and assigned an A plus rating to Posco's $300 million 7.125 percent bond due 2006.

"Posco's rating reflects the company's dominant position in the Korean steel market, strong performance thanks to a high degree of operating efficiency, and a stable, although moderately high, debt level," S&P said in a statement.

Posco has the largest share of the Korean steel market, which is growing steadily amid economic expansion, and it has benefited from limited domestic competition and favourable regulatory treatment, the agency said.

"Steel exports, which are an important source of earnings for Posco, face risks in the international market such as cyclicality and intense competition. But the currently low Korean won exchange rate and Posco's efforts to reduce costs through rationalization are mitigating factors," S&P said.
Posco's debt usage is fairly high but remains stable, as internally generated funds finance a significant portion of continual capacity expansion, the agency said.

"Also, the company's capital structure is stronger than it appears because of an extremely conservative depreciation rate that understates equity. As one of the most profitable integrated steel makers in the world, Posco's ability to meet its debt obligations is strong."
S&P said the outlook is stable.
